archived_sample.provenance: Reconstructed from the archived source's enumeration order and seed. The archived receipt gives aggregate counts.

archive_comparison.P5: All archived counts agree. The original receipt does not give individual sign patterns and orders.
archive_comparison.P8_F3: The archived F3 control uses only the ascending creation order. The ternary descending creation order was added here.

method.P5_prediction: Use the reversal signs times the inversion signs for each exact order. A carrying order allows any additional character of the even words.
method.P8_design_id: Zero-based order in the product of LOCAL_ASSIGNMENTS across readers, with the last reader varying fastest.
method.carrying: All full correlations at even flip settings are sharp and their signs fail the character identity.
method.exact: All fixed-label outcome probabilities agree with the reversal-signed state read by Z and X.
method.state: Chronological left creation and exact signed occupation states, checked on every fresh-pair completion.
method.tables: Exact Walsh coefficients of the outcome probabilities from the projected Z and F operators.
method.ternary_benchmark: Fourier inversion of the target reproduced all 64 cells of the specified four-settings benchmark.
